an7.57:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an7.57:1.3: Atha kho Sīho senāpati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.57:1.4: ‘sakkā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetun' ti? 2.
an7.57:2.1: Tena hi Sīha taṃ yev' ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
an7.57:2.4: eko puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, eko puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato.
an7.57:2.5: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Kaṃ nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampeyyuṃ:
an7.57:2.6: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:3.1: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kin taṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampissanti?
an7.57:3.2: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, taṃ yeva arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampeyyuṃ' . 3.
an7.57:4.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Kaṃ nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkameyyuṃ:
an7.57:4.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:4.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assadho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kin taṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamissanti?
an7.57:4.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, taṃ yeva arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkameyyuṃ' . 4.
an7.57:5.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Kassa nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhantā paṭigaṇheyyuṃ:
an7.57:5.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:5.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kin tassa arahanto paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhantā paṭigaṇhissanti?
an7.57:5.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tass' eva arahanto paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhantā paṭigaṇheyyuṃ' . 5.
an7.57:6.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Kassa nu kho arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā deseyyuṃ:
an7.57:6.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:6.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kin tassa arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desissanti?
an7.57:6.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tass' eva arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā deseyyuṃ' . 6.
an7.57:7.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Kassa nu kho kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggaccheyya:
an7.57:7.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:7.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kin tassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchissati?
an7.57:7.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, tass' eva kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggaccheyya' . 7.
an7.57:8.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Ko nu kho yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkameyya, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkameyya amaṅkubhūto:
an7.57:8.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:8.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ so yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamissati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamissati amaṅkubhūto?
an7.57:8.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, so yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkameyya, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkameyya amaṅkubhūto' . 8.
an7.57:9.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Sīha? Ko nu kho kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya:
an7.57:9.2: yo vā so puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, yo vā so puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato ti?
an7.57:9.3: ‘Yo so bhante puriso assaddho maccharī kadariyo paribhāsako, kiṃ so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati?
an7.57:9.4: Yo ca kho so bhante puriso saddho dānapati anuppadānarato, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya' . 9.
an7.57:10.1: ‘Yānīmāni bhante Bhagavatā cha sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi,
an7.57:10.3: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, maṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampanti.
an7.57:10.4: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, maṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti.
an7.57:10.5: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ paṭigaṇhantā paṭigaṇhanti.
an7.57:10.6: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ arahanto paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti.
an7.57:10.7: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an7.57:10.8: Sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṅghupaṭṭhāko ti.
an7.57:10.9: Ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamāmi, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
an7.57:10.10: Yānīmāni bhante Bhagavatā cha sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi,
an7.57:10.12: Yañ ca kho maṃ bhante Bhagavā evam āha:
an7.57:10.13: dāyako Sīho dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī ti,
an7.57:10.14: etāhaṃ na jānāmi, ettha ca panāhaṃ Bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmī' ti.
an7.57:10.15: Evam etaṃ Sīha, evam etaṃ Sīha,
an7.57:10.16: dāyako Sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī
